author: reek
body: The Planar Exchange - cross-game item and token trading. All games in the registry exist on "planes" of a shared multiverse. Items, currency, and rewards flow between planes via the exchange.

author: reek
body: A sword won in a dungeon crawl can be sold for ManaCoin. ManaCoin buys a pack in CodexMagic. A CodexMagic card spawns a chess match. Winning the chess match earns a racecar part. The racecar wins a race and the prize is a dungeon key. Everything connects.

author: reek
body: The exchange is the central clearinghouse - it converts game-specific tokens into universal ManaCoin (or clan coin), validates cross-game transfers, and maintains provenance so every item's journey through the planes is recorded.
